> [!WARNING]
> Early alpha: expect graphical, animation and sound bugs, and plenty of rough edges. Reports are welcome in the issues.

The first build of sh2-vita: Silent Hill 2 on the PS Vita, at 960 x 544 and 30 fps, with single-screen menus drawn after the original game's and the Enhanced Edition's font, art and maps.

The game should, at least in theory, be playable from start to finish: saves from every area have been tested and no game-breaking bugs have been found. What is left is graphical and animation glitches, sound issues and the like. What is open is in the README.
